evidence: The available reporting leading up to November 23, 2018 reflects intense market distress and capitulation following steep back-to-back weekly selloffs. Major themes include widespread investor panic, mining operations filing for bankruptcy (Giga Watt) with mining hardware sold for scrap, and Norway revoking electricity tax subsidies for miners. While long-term venture capitalists express continued belief in Bitcoin and Lightning Network capacity grew modestly, near-term momentum remains dominated by severe downward pressure and negative market sentiment, pointing to a below-even probability of an upward recovery over the next 24 hours.
limitations: All evidence stems from third-party crypto-specialist reporting rather than authenticated live Yahoo finance wires.
Duplicate reporting observed regarding Norway mining power subsidies (treated as a single event).
General sentiment coverage lacks tick-level order book or high-frequency spot liquidity data.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
